text_block_list.text:
—Valentine's Day. On this holiday of 
giving presents to the one you love, an 
incident occurred.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-saaaan, this is terribleee. The 
sink ate the chocolateeee!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I was making chocolate for you, Trainer, 
and I accidentally knocked the bowl 
over...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"And then the melted chocolate went gulp 
right down the drain! Waaaaaaaah!"

For now, I calm her down. Apparently, she 
failed while making handmade chocolate and 
accidentally poured it down the kitchen 
sink.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, I'm sorry... In that case, I'll try 
it one more time.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'll remake it right away, so please 
follow me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyauuuu, this time I dropped it before it 
even melted, aaahh.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, I forgot to buy chocolate. I gotta 
go shopping one more time.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huhhh?! My wallet, my wallet is nowhere to 
be founddd. Did I drop it somewhereee?

Far from being finished, it was drifting 
further away. At this rate, we won't make 
it before sunset.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, so sorry~. I really want to 
express my gratitude... I really want to, 
and yet...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I can't even give him a single homemade 
chocolate... Auugh, what am I supposed to 
do~?
choice_data_list: Wanna share a chocolate parfait together?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Choco parfait?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, this looks so delicious. The melted 
chocolate is drizzling all over the ice 
cream.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Is it really okay for me to eat this?
choice_data_list: Sure. I ordered enough for two

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Wow, thank you so much~

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ehehehe, yummy~♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, thank you so much for today. It was 
very delicious, but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
“Still, is this really alright? All I'm 
doing is just eating away.”
choice_data_list:
If it was delicious, then that's all that 
matters!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so...? If you say so, Trainer, 
then...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, fueled by chocolate parfait power, 
I'll do my best! Starting again tomorrow!

Though I didn't receive any chocolates, I 
thoroughly enjoyed Valentine's sweets with 
Meisho Doto from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, so sorry~. I really want to 
express my gratitude, yet I can't even 
give you a single piece of handmade 
chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If it's come to this... If it's come to 
this, instead of chocolates...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I give you... meeee!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You see it in fairy tales, right? Like, 
"If it's come to this, please eat me 
instead."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I can't make chocolate, but I can become 
chocolate. Trainer, look, I'm chocolate~!

I couldn't quite make sense of what she 
was saying. After calming her down for the 
moment, I started looking for a chocolate 
substitute...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"H-Huh? Trainer, there's a poster put up 
in the game center."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Let's take super cute purikura for 
Valentine's"?

Apparently, you can make special 
Valentine-themed stickers.
choice_data_list:
Then instead of chocolate, how about a 
sticker?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fweh? Is something like that really 
okayyy?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Umm, let's make the background... look 
like this. I think this should do it...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Will this do? I'm not really sure what 
'lovey-dovey vibes' are, but I'll do my 
best not to break the camera!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ready, and, Hapi-Hapi-Happy, Happy 
Valentine's♪
(*Snap!*)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Kyupiin! Howawaanâ

Instead of chocolates, I received some 
very cute stickers. Since I have them, I 
think I'll put some up in the Trainer's 
Room too.
